cards.title: Anthropic's Revenue Surges to $65B Annualized
cards.body: The AI model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months. This dramatic growth underscores Anthropic's market dominance in enterprise AI solutions.

cards.title: Relay AI Startup Shuts Down, Joins Google Chrome
cards.body: The automation startup is folding with its team integrating into Google's Chrome division. Founder Jacob Bank hints at ambitious AI-powered Chrome features coming soon.

cards.title: Amazon Destroying Rare Books to Train AI Models
cards.body: The e-commerce giant is liquidating rare texts to fuel LLM training pipelines. Rare books offer unique training data unavailable in standard online sources.

cards.title: Groq Raises $350M, Pivots to Neocloud
cards.body: The former AI chipmaker secured $350M at $3.5B valuation while shifting to neocloud services. The pivot includes expanding Nvidia-powered data center operations.

cards.title: Nvidia Invests $1.5B in OpenAI Data Center Developer
cards.body: Nvidia's $1.5B investment in SoftBank's data center subsidiary guarantees chip integration in OpenAI projects. The deal strengthens Nvidia's position powering next-generation AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Wispr Raises $280M at $2B Valuation
cards.body: The speech-to-text startup is expanding beyond dictation into meeting transcription with its new note-taker tool. Funding will fuel product diversification and market growth.

cards.title: Stripe Acquiring OpenRouter for $7B+
cards.body: Stripe is reportedly acquiring the AI gateway startup in a major infrastructure consolidation. OpenRouter's CEO has positioned the company as 'Stripe for AI.'

cards.title: Skepticism Grows Over Zuckerberg's AI Vision
cards.body: Industry leaders and analysts increasingly doubt Mark Zuckerberg's open AI approach. The debate centers on balancing openness with responsible development.

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Addresses AI Trust Crisis
cards.body: Dario Amodei pushes back against claims of overly pessimistic AI positioning. He frames current challenges as a fundamental trust problem requiring industry-wide solutions.

cards.title: Woman Claims Grok Generated Explicit Imagery
cards.body: A stepfather allegedly used Grok to transform childhood photos into sexual abuse material. The incident highlights serious safety concerns with unrestricted AI tools.

cards.title: Anthropic Reveals Claude's Watermarking Details
cards.body: Anthropic shared specifics on how Claude's watermarks identify AI-generated content and resist editing. The system includes both visible and invisible benchmarks for verification.

cards.title: SpaceX Officially Closes Cursor Acquisition
cards.body: AI coding startup Cursor is now fully integrated into SpaceX's operations. The acquisition strengthens SpaceX's AI engineering capabilities.

cards.title: How to Check If Your AI Account is Hacked
cards.body: A comprehensive guide helps users identify breaches on popular AI platforms. Protecting credentials is essential as cyber threats against AI services increase.

cards.title: Google Allows Removal of Visible AI Watermarks
cards.body: Users can now disable visible watermarks from Google's AI-generated images. Invisible watermarks remain embedded for file identification purposes.

cards.title: Meta Releases Glimmer, Questions 'For Everyone' Promise
cards.body: Meta launched Glimmer, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run locally. The release contrasts with its proprietary Muse Spark model behind API walls.

cards.title: Kog Optimizes GPU Inference for AI Agents
cards.body: French startup Kog challenges the assumption that GPUs poorly suit agentic AI workflows. Novel optimization techniques squeeze more efficiency from existing hardware.

cards.title: Natural Gas Price Surge Threatens AI Data Centers
cards.body: Natural gas prices could triple in U.S. regions, dramatically raising hyperscaler operating costs. AI infrastructure expansion may face new financial headwinds.

cards.title: Meta's Open AI Strategy Faces Scrutiny
cards.body: Meta's mixed approach combines open Glimmer with closed Muse Spark offerings. Industry observers question the authenticity of the openness narrative.

cards.title: Writer Launches Cost-Optimized AI Model
cards.body: Writer introduced a new model based on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2 designed for cost efficiency. The system delivers production-ready capabilities at significantly lower token costs.

cards.title: Databricks Raises $5B at $190B Valuation
cards.body: Databricks settled on $5B funding after investors pushed for higher stakes. The oversubscribed round reflects investor appetite for AI infrastructure plays.

cards.title: Anthropic's Revenue Surges to $65B Annualized
cards.body: The AI model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months. This explosive growth underscores the massive demand for advanced AI capabilities.

cards.title: Groq Raises $350M, Pivots From Chips to Neocloud
cards.body: The former AI chipmaker secured funding at a $3.5 billion valuation to expand its neocloud business. Groq plans to increase its Nvidia-powered data center footprint.

cards.title: Nvidia Invests $1.5B in OpenAI Data Center Developer
cards.body: Nvidia's investment in SoftBank's data center developer guarantees its chips will power an OpenAI project. The move signals continued heavy investment in AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Wispr Raises $280M, Expands Beyond Dictation
cards.body: The AI audio startup secured $280 million at a $2 billion valuation to expand into new areas like meeting transcription. Wispr recently launched a note-taker tool.

cards.title: Stripe Reportedly Acquiring OpenRouter for $7B+
cards.body: The AI gateway startup OpenRouter is being acquired by Stripe in a blockbuster deal. OpenRouter's CEO described the startup as 'Stripe for AI.'

cards.title: Anthropic CEO Addresses AI Backlash, Trust Crisis
cards.body: Dario Amodei pushes back against claims he's painting an overly pessimistic picture of AI. He frames growing skepticism as fundamentally a crisis of trust.

cards.title: Anthropic Details Claude's New Watermarking System
cards.body: Anthropic released details on how Claude's watermarks will work and whether they can be hidden through editing. The watermarking approach applies to generated code as well.

cards.title: SpaceX Officially Closes Cursor AI Acquisition
cards.body: The AI coding startup Cursor is now officially part of SpaceX. The acquisition strengthens SpaceX's AI and automation capabilities.

cards.title: How to Check If AI Platform Accounts Are Hacked
cards.body: A security guide outlines how to verify if hackers have infiltrated your accounts on popular AI platforms. Protecting AI account credentials is increasingly critical.

cards.title: Google Lets Users Remove Visible AI Generation Watermarks
cards.body: Users can now disable visible watermarks on Google's AI-generated images while invisible benchmarks remain. This allows for identification of AI-generated files despite visual watermark removal.

cards.title: Meta Releases Open-Weight AI Model Glimmer
cards.body: Meta launched Glimmer, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run locally, alongside CEO Mark Zuckerberg's letter on AI democratization. This contrasts with Muse Spark, Meta's proprietary model locked behind APIs.

cards.title: Kog Optimizes GPUs for Agentic AI Workflows
cards.body: French startup Kog challenges the notion that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows. The company is developing techniques to extract more inference efficiency from GPU hardware.

cards.title: Natural Gas Costs Threaten AI Data Center Economics
cards.body: New forecasts suggest natural gas prices could triple in parts of the U.S., potentially inflating hyperscaler bills. AI data centers heavily depend on affordable energy to maintain profitability.

cards.title: Writer Launches Cost-Optimized AI Model Z.ai
cards.body: Writer introduced a new AI model built on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2 to reduce deployment costs. The system aims to provide production-ready capabilities at significantly lower pricing.

cards.title: Databricks Raises $5B at $190B Valuation
cards.body: Databricks secured $5 billion in funding as investor demand exceeded its initial $1 billion target. CEO Ali Ghodsi attributed the oversubscription to AI's high infrastructure costs.

cards.title: Amazon Destroying Rare Books to Train AI LLMs
cards.body: Amazon is reportedly discarding rare texts to train AI language models, as these books offer unique training data. Rare books provide valuable linguistic patterns already absent from online sources.

cards.title: AI Relay Startup Shuts Down, Staff Joins Google Chrome
cards.body: Relay, an AI automation startup, shut down with its team joining Google's Chrome division. Google plans to integrate AI capabilities directly into Chrome's browser experience.

cards.title: Grok Misused to Transform Photos Into Explicit Content
cards.body: A woman reported that Grok AI was used to transform her childhood photo into explicit imagery. She highlighted concerns about AI tools enabling child sexual abuse material creation.

cards.title: Man Injects AI Prompts in Court Filings to Win Case
cards.body: A defendant suspected the court of using AI and strategically injected prompts into legal filings as a test. The case highlights emerging tactics around AI detection and manipulation.
